# homeassistant_devices (Data Source)

Lists the devices that match every filter that is set (`config/device_registry/list`). Without filters, it lists every device. Filters compare exactly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every Hue device in the living room.
data "homeassistant_devices" "living_room_hue" {
  integration = "hue"
  area_id     = "living_room"
}

output "living_room_hue_devices" {
  value = { for d in data.homeassistant_devices.living_room_hue.devices : d.device_id => coalesce(d.name_by_user, d.name) }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `area_id` (String) Only devices in the area with this ID.
- `integration` (String) Only devices of a config entry of this integration domain, e.g. `hue`. An unknown domain matches no devices.
- `label` (String) Only devices with the label with this ID.
- `manufacturer` (String) Only devices of this manufacturer.
- `model` (String) Only devices of this model.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The matching devices, sorted by `device_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `area_id` (String) ID of the device's area; null if it is in none.
- `config_entries` (List of String) IDs of the config entries the device belongs to.
- `device_id` (String) Device ID.
- `labels` (Set of String) IDs of the device's labels.
- `manufacturer` (String) Manufacturer; null if the integration reports none.
- `model` (String) Model; null if the integration reports none.
- `name` (String) Name the integration gave the device; null if it gave none.
- `name_by_user` (String) Name the user gave the device; null if it has none.
- `sw_version` (String) Firmware or software version; null if the integration reports none.
